paragraphs: Rabbi Yose ben Kifar: Yevamot 11b. There is also R"Y ben Kipar; see their entries.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The second name is abbreviated ר״י and is left unexpanded; the plural “their entries” suggests more than one person.

The actual Davidson Yevamot 11b paragraph explicitly has Rabbi Yose ben Kifar. The separate ר"י occurrence is retained as R"Y in the new body without resolving its name or title; the current note is preserved verbatim. Hyman’s plural cross-reference remains an unbound pointer, not a new count or identity decision.
